Chilliwack's 55+ apartment condos cluster in two places: Spadina Avenue in downtown Chilliwack Proper, and Knight Road and Amber Drive in Sardis, west of Vedder Road. 5500.
Ivy Green, 45775 Spadina Avenue, is a three-storey freehold strata condo building downtown, listed in building directories as completed in the mid-1990s.
Spadina Regency, 45765 Spadina Avenue, is the second downtown 55+ strata on the same block — a concrete building from the late 1980s in directory records, ten civic numbers from Ivy Green.
Knight Lodge, 45660 Knight Road, Sardis, is a four-storey freehold strata condo building completed in 1989, west of Vedder Road in Sardis West Vedder.
Mountainview Estates, 46966 Yale Road, Chilliwack Proper East, is a 55+ freehold strata building on Yale Road.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Specific to these buildings: the registered bylaw of the individual building states who may occupy a unit, and the Form B Information Certificate is where a buyer confirms it for Ivy Green, Spadina Regency, Knight Lodge, The Sapphire or Mountainview Estates.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Check the exact civic address, not the street.

The Sardis 55+ buildings sit west of Vedder Road, while Sardis Sports Complex, 5725 Tyson Road, and Sardis Library, 5819 Tyson Road, sit east of the Knight Road area — recreation is a drive or bus ride across Vedder Road.

Curbside collection changed May 1, 2026, to weekly compostables and alternating bi-weekly garbage and recycling; an apartment strata normally handles waste internally, so this matters mainly when comparing a condo with a Cottage Grove rancher.
City utilities are billed quarterly; in an apartment condo, water, sewer and garbage are commonly carried inside strata fees instead — a building-by-building document question.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in the City of Chilliwack, a listed taxable area, so an empty 55+ condo still needs the annual declaration.

BC Transit, not TransLink, runs Chilliwack transit. Route 51 Vedder runs Downtown to the University of the Fraser Valley (UFV) campus via Vedder Road, linking the Spadina Avenue buildings with the Sardis side.
Route 52 Evans runs Cottonwood Mall to Downtown via Evans Road, serving the corridor of the urgent and primary care centre at 7955 Evans Road.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Floodplain Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 sets floodplain areas and Flood Construction Levels city-wide; for an existing apartment, the practical check is the parkade, storage and flood history in the strata documents.
The Sardis-Vedder Aquifer is a drinking-water Development Permit Area under Schedule D-1 of the 2050 OCP, relevant to any redevelopment of a Sardis strata site.
Confirm the registered 55+ bylaw and any exemption recorded for the unit before subjects are removed — directory labels do not replace the Form B.

faq.q: Which 55+ condos are downtown and which are in Sardis?
faq.a: Ivy Green at 45775 Spadina Avenue and Spadina Regency at 45765 Spadina Avenue are downtown, near the hospital precinct. Knight Lodge at 45660 Knight Road and The Sapphire at 7685 Amber Drive are in Sardis, south of Highway 1 and west of Vedder Road, on the shopping and recreation side around Vedder and Tyson roads.

faq.q: Can I rent out a 55+ condo if I move into care?
faq.a: British Columbia law removed strata rental-restriction bylaws, so a strata cannot ban long-term renting, but a valid 55+ age bylaw still controls who may live there, including a tenant. The tenant must meet the age rule or an exemption. Read the building's registered bylaws before promising a family member or tenant that they can move in.

faq.q: How close is a downtown 55+ condo to the hospital?
faq.a: Chilliwack General Hospital is at 45600 Menholm Road, in the same Chilliwack Proper precinct as the Spadina Avenue buildings; Fraser Health calls it a community hospital providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services. No walking time is stated, because no source measured one for a specific building — check the route, including the Hodgins Avenue entrance Fraser Health directs outpatients to.

faq.q: Is there urgent care on the Sardis side?
faq.a: No separate Sardis centre was found. Fraser Health's Chilliwack Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #104 – 7955 Evans Road, on the west side, co-located with the rural primary care centre. A Knight Road or Amber Drive buyer uses that centre and the Menholm Road hospital, the same services a downtown buyer uses.
